investigation_notes.Description: A successful Office 365 login was observed from Santiago de Querétaro, Mexico, which is outside the user's typical region. There is no available IP reputation, ISP usage, VPN status, or prior client-confirmed activity for this country in the alert evidence. Although the endpoint is company-managed and MFA was used, the lack of corroborating IP/ISP and historical confirmation raises concern and warrants higher priority review.
